model_description: Segment Anything Model 3 - unified foundation model for promptable segmentation in images.

verified_output_example.finding: Per-prompt JSON {masks:[N][1][H][W] 0/1, boxes:[N][4] pixel xyxy, scores:[N]}; masks at input resolution (1024x1024 example, square so H/W order unproven)

image.description: Input image, accepts JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP files.

prompts.description: List of per concept JSON strings that represent prompt objects, that contain: text (string), positive_boxes (list of lists of four floats), negative_boxes (list of lists of four floats), positive_points (list of lists of two floats),  negative_points (list of lists of two floats). At least one of text, positive_boxes or positive_points must be provided.All coordinates are normalized to the range [0, 1]. Boxes are in the format of: center_x, center_y, width, height.

visualize.description: Whether to return prediction results as per prompt PNG file.

concat_input.description: Whether to concatenate the input prompts to output JSON files under `input` key.

offset_masks.description: Whether to return the masks as cut-outs along with the mask offset (x, y) of the upper left corner in the original image pixel space.

split_output.description: Whether to split the output JSON files into separate files per prompt.

backbone_output.description: Whether to return the backbone output as a PT file.
